verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a REST API for querying requests (helicone-docs-15) and an HQL query language (helicone-docs-16), plus a discoverable OpenAPI spec (helicone-probe-3) and llms.txt for AI-agent-friendly docs (helicone-probe-1), enabling programmatic access to traces/sessions/metrics for debugging. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated MCP server offering, nor explicit documentation of querying eval results via API, so an agent's ability to pull all three (traces, metrics, evals) through a single API/MCP interface is only partially substantiated. missing for 10: explicit MCP server documentation, API endpoints/examples for querying eval results specifically, and independent confirmation of agent-based API usage for debugging.
